About the job
Alpenrand Chemicals is looking for an interim head of group reporting to bridge a vacancy of nine months.

Your responsibilities
Lead the group reporting team of six
Own the consolidated financial statements under IFRS
Prepare the migration of the consolidation to SAP Group Reporting

Requirements
Master's degree in Business Administration or Economics
10+ years of experience in group reporting and consolidation under IFRS
Experience with LucaNet or SAP Group Reporting
Fluent English

What we offer
Day rate: 1,250 EUR
Start: immediately, duration 9 months
Hybrid: two days per week on site in Stuttgart
